changes: Added a universal distinction between legitimate externally-backed waits and Project Leader-controlled internal operations such as compare/diff, audit, reconciliation, local validation, evidence reading and planning.

Added INTERNAL_OPERATION_STALLED after two canonical live liveness observations without a new tool result, durable evidence or control-plane transition, routing immediately through existing LIVENESS_RECONCILE_REQUIRED to Recovery Guardian.

Recovery now reconstructs durable state first, skips a stalled operation when existing evidence already determines the next step, otherwise switches to a smaller/bounded read strategy, never repeats an ambiguous write as a liveness probe, and counts repeated stalls toward the existing no-progress ceiling.

Documented the irreducible platform limitation: a host/tool call that itself is frozen and does not yield execution control cannot run Recovery concurrently; the first action after control returns is durable reconstruction/liveness reconciliation.
Added universal smoke/contract coverage and aligned canonical docs, roles, packaged skills and recovery references.
Bumped package identity to Project Leader 0.6.3 and Recovery Guardian 0.5.3.
